nodes.label: Breakpoints · App Shell composition
nodes.rationale: The observed structure composes Header, collapsed Sidebar, and a variable content Slot. The component name does not establish a responsive breakpoint matrix.

nodes.label: Slot · variable content cardinality
nodes.rationale: The empty native Slot fills the remaining horizontal region; observed content does not constrain cardinality.

nodes.label: Reuse Header and Sidebar destination contracts
nodes.rationale: Composition scope reuses destination Header/Sidebar. Full nested main API, alternatives and visual/typography internals are not rebuilt or duplicated.

nodes.label: Source variables do not establish target canonical parity
nodes.rationale: Source references are inventoried, with source alias closure and modes unresolved; target canonical parity is verified independently.

nodes.label: SRC-AS-UNKNOWN-001 · scoped evidence limitations
nodes.rationale: Complete source visual/typography projection and dependency alternatives are not duplicated; this does not define a destination contract.

nodes.label: APP-SHELL-001 · exclusive destination rules
nodes.rationale: Source stays unchanged; destination rules live exclusively in APP-SHELL-001.

nodes.label: E002 · 48 instances / 27 mains /49 variable references /0 named styles
Conversation · read-only source evidence
nodes.rationale: Source inspection is evidence, not an approved normative contract or an implementation in AI Design System.

nodes.label: Molecules | Anticipa | Conversation
nodes.rationale: The root set is a showcase; Message Sent, answer Beni, answer Navi and Text Field are content types, not equivalent states or a Cartesian variant product.

nodes.label: P-SLOTS · REQUIRED for variable Conversation content
nodes.rationale: Composite answers, previews and actions vary in composition. Seven native Slots were observed, but consumer instance operations were not tested and sample cardinality is not a limit.

nodes.label: Conversation content-type variants
nodes.rationale: The public variant axis describes message types; public composer/message state matrix remains undefined.

nodes.label: Conversation dependencies · partially resolved
nodes.rationale: Identity and locality were read; active properties, overrides and owning set definitions were not fully resolved. Remote library/file/version metadata are not exposed by the MCP.

nodes.label: Anticipa token aliases · source evidence only
nodes.rationale: Raw valuesByMode and aliases are preserved without flattening or adoption as target tokens. Collection names, terminal resolution and consumer mode are unresolved. Matching names do not establish local destination bindings.

nodes.label: Color/text/base → color/text/primary
nodes.rationale: The local source Color/text/base aliases the remote semantic text/primary; terminal resolution and consumer mode remain unchecked.

nodes.label: Conversation nested prototype reactions
nodes.rationale: Conditional branches and destinations are not fully inspected. These reactions do not establish backend send/upload/audio behavior, real clipboard copying or persistence.

nodes.label: Conversation behavior and accessibility require definition
undefined: Loading, Error, Disabled and delivery states
nodes.rationale: Nested reactions, icon presence and a Figma render do not demonstrate these functions or accessible web implementation.

nodes.label: Conversation U1–U5 · source intake limitations
nodes.rationale: The componentProperties getter failed with existing component-set errors. Text/vector paint details and typography segments remain partial, and intake contains no destination inventory, mapping, normative construction, implementation QA or publication.

nodes.label: External Anticipa file requires applicable explicit delegation
nodes.rationale: Legacy migration delegation must not be extended to this external source file without an applicable explicit decision. This source document itself authorizes neither remote dependency copying nor internal Anticipa token adoption.

nodes.label: Conversation demo content is not product policy
nodes.rationale: The twenty sample texts, fiscal query, BENI/NAVI labels, preview, indicator/dashboard buttons, disclaimer and placeholder do not establish tax rules, length limits, real capabilities or agent policy.

nodes.label: Read-only source evidence versus destination authority
nodes.rationale: Source IDs are not AI Design System IDs; source inspection must remain separate from approved token mapping, destination construction and implementation QA.
